g.text: US115 — Create a maintenance record (command side, B3b and event)
exception → rollback: no record, no read-model row, no event
apply to THIS replica's read model
Aircraft Management then publishes AircraftStatusChanged (UNDER_MAINTENANCE): Maintenance updates KNOWN_AIRCRAFT,
Aircraft Management its AIRCRAFT_MOOD (/api/v2/unicorns: GROUNDED_AND_GRUMPY). Flight Routes only schedules AVAILABLE aircraft.
